chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Sparks as road manager; the band books itself
summary: Sparks becomes road manager; the band has no other manager and books itself.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: WELL BEN BECAME (inaudible), HE QUIT PLAYING DIDN'T HE, DIDN'T HE QUIT PLAYING? DIDN'T HE QUIT PLAYING TO BECOME THE MANAGER? I THINK HE WAS ROAD MANAGER.
AFTER YOU LEFT TEXAS, YOU DIDN'T HAVE ANOTHER MANAGER, UNTIL THAT GUY UP IN NEW ENGLAND, KARL ROBERTS. YOU HAD NO OTHER MANAGER.
I don't know of any other.
YOU GUYS WERE REALLY BOOKING YOURSELVES.
